changelog:
Initial release of the siyuan-note-cli skill.

- Provides command-line integration with SiYuan Note, enabling querying, creation, and modification of notes, notebooks, documents, and blocks.
- Establishes best practices and workflows for locating, reading, and writing notes, including the use of the AgentWork notebook by default.
- Recommends reading the "AI Assistant Guide" note before all operations for context and instructions.
- Advises on safe operation boundaries, preferring new document creation unless the user explicitly requests modification.
- Details preferred usage patterns for passing content and formatting, and cautions against common pitfalls.
- Includes reference commands and configuration guidance for users.
